declarations.type_text:
∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (q : OracleTemplate.Muon.Public) (N : ℕ),
  q.T = N + 1 →
    1 ≤ q.B →
      ∀ (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
        (g : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat q.m q.n) (j : Fin (N + 1)) (tape : ℕ → Ω),
        OracleTemplate.execute (OracleTemplate.Muon.sampleOracle P g) (outputs.Algorithms.MuonTuning.randomMuon q N)
            (fun x => q.T * q.B) j tape =
          (OracleTemplate.Muon.trajectory q g tape ↑j).2.1

declarations.type_text:
∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {m n : ℕ} (N : ℕ) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n → ℝ) (W : Fin (N + 1) → Ω → OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat m n),
  (∀ (j : Fin (N + 1)), Measurable (W j)) →
    (∀ (j : Fin (N + 1)), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f (W j ω))) ↑P) →
      (Measurable fun z => W z.1 z.2) ∧
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f (W z.1 z.2)))
            ((PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (N + 1))).toMeasure.prod ↑P) ∧
          ∫ (z : Fin (N + 1) × Ω),
              OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm
                (gradient f (W z.1 z.2)) ∂(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Fin (N + 1))).toMeasure.prod ↑P =
            1 / ↑(N + 1) * ∑ j, ∫ (ω : Ω), OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm (gradient f (W j ω)) ∂↑P
